required_events.event: Amy stirs a pot of oatmeal on the stove while Will and Amber giggle over pancakes at the kitchen table, sunlight filtering through blinds casting a warm glow across the countertop.
Suddenly a groaning figure bursts through the front door, zombie claws scraping against wood.

Without hesitation Amy scoops up Will in her left arm and grabs Amber’s small hand with her right, pushing past the startled children into the back patio and closing the sliding glass doors behind them to keep the undead at bay.
The kitchen feels suddenly empty as she steps inside again; silence is broken by a thud when another zombie slips through the front window.
Amy runs to the pantry, pulls out her hidden arsenal—a pistol tucked beneath the stove and a katana slid into a steel case beside it.

She fires the first shot, bullet striking a zombie’s skull with a crack of bone, then swings the katana slicing another through the chest as it lunges forward; one by one she dispatches each attacker with pistol blasts and swift slashes while new zombies keep emerging from every corner.

When the last zombie falls onto the kitchen tiles, Amy wipes sweat from her brow, turns toward the back patio again, runs out into the backyard, scoops Will up in one arm and Amber in the other, pulling them behind her as she sprints back inside for safety.

The children cling to her shoulders with eyes wide relief; Amy closes the doors behind them breathing hard but alive, tucks the pistol and katana into their hiding spots once more before turning to face whatever else might come through the front door.

phases.required_end_state: End at the expanded story's stated conclusion.
